access_utc_basis: Per-source timestamps record the UTC time of the web retrieval batch. GitHub repository sources are pinned to an observed full commit SHA; living documentation is marked unversioned.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.released_version_or_commit: W3C Recommendation, 2024-12-12; exact dated publication
sources.observed_operation: Opened the exact dated W3C version and reviewed its version/status header, abstract and listed success criteria.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: 2.1.4 applies when shortcuts use printable character keys alone, with turn-off, remap, or focus-only alternatives; 4.1.3 covers status messages programmatically exposed without focus. WCAG is web-focused; use WCAG2ICT for software context.
sources.applicability: Primary stable accessibility standard; design reference for the chooser, but desktop applicability requires the separate WCAG2ICT interpretation and actual product testing.
sources.evidence: Relevant criteria cover keyboard availability, no keyboard trap, key shortcut safety, focus order, non-color cues, names/roles/states, and status announcements.

critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened exact dated W3C Recommendation and read criterion text and relevant definitions.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: SC 2.1.4 concerns character-only shortcuts in web content; 4.1.3 is phrased for content implemented using markup languages. No native desktop conformance claim.
critic_independent_review.applicability: Design reference; desktop interpretation also requires WCAG2ICT and actual platform validation.

sources.title: Guidance on Applying WCAG 2 to Non-Web ICT (WCAG2ICT)
sources.released_version_or_commit: W3C Group Note, 2025-12-11 (current Note at retrieval)
sources.locator: Scope/status, and guidance for WCAG 2.2 keyboard and status-message criteria in non-web software
sources.observed_operation: Opened the current Note and overview; reviewed publication status and non-web scope.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Informative guidance only; it does not set normative requirements and does not specify which criteria must apply to every product.
sources.applicability: Best source for translating WCAG concepts to desktop software without claiming conformance.
sources.evidence: Explains how WCAG criteria can be considered for non-web documents and software, including native applications.

critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened W3C note and read its status, scope and caveats.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Informative Group Note, not normative or a standard; not sufficient alone to ensure non-web software accessibility.
critic_independent_review.applicability: Desktop interpretation aid, not conformance evidence.

sources.title: Understanding Success Criterion 2.1.1 Keyboard
sources.released_version_or_commit: WCAG 2.1 supporting Understanding document; living explanatory resource
sources.locator: Success Criterion and intent
sources.observed_operation: Opened the W3C explanatory page and reviewed the keyboard operation requirement.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Normative criterion requires operation through keyboard interface without specific per-keystroke timing, except movement-path-dependent underlying functions; this page itself is informative.
sources.applicability: Supports complete keyboard-only test cases; apply to desktop via WCAG2ICT guidance.
sources.evidence: Use every chooser action, dismissal and return path without mouse or timed keystrokes.

sources.title: Understanding Success Criterion 2.4.3 Focus Order
sources.released_version_or_commit: WCAG 2.2 supporting Understanding document; living explanatory resource
sources.locator: SC 2.4.3, intent, meaningful focus order examples
sources.observed_operation: Opened the W3C supporting page and reviewed focus-order intent/examples.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: The web criterion assesses meaning and operability of sequential focus; focused non-operable content is not categorically forbidden but should not impede operation.
sources.applicability: Grounds logical search/results Tab order and return focus; not a screen-reader behavior guarantee.
sources.evidence: Dialog/search/result order should remain understandable to both keyboard and AT users.

sources.title: Understanding Success Criterion 1.4.1 Use of Color
sources.released_version_or_commit: WCAG 2.2 supporting Understanding document; living explanatory resource
sources.locator: SC 1.4.1 and intent
sources.observed_operation: Opened W3C explanatory page.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Color may be used but not as the only visual means to convey information.
sources.applicability: Show unavailable state through text/state/icon shape as well as color; validate contrast/focus separately.
sources.evidence: Availability and disabled reasons need non-color indication.

sources.title: Understanding Success Criterion 4.1.3 Status Messages
sources.released_version_or_commit: WCAG 2.1 supporting Understanding document (criterion retained in WCAG 2.2); living resource
sources.locator: Definition of status message; search result-count examples; interruption intent
sources.observed_operation: Opened W3C supporting page and reviewed examples around search results.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: The changed result list itself is not necessarily a status message; concise text such as result count or no results may be. Criterion is for messages not changing context/focus.
sources.applicability: Announce changed counts/empty state and command registry changes sparingly; avoid a live announcement for each keystroke.
sources.evidence: Supports debounced status summary while leaving keyboard-driven active-row announcements intact.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide Combobox Pattern
sources.released_version_or_commit: Living WAI-ARIA APG pattern; no immutable release version shown
sources.locator: About; combobox keyboard interaction; listbox popup interaction; aria-activedescendant notes
sources.observed_operation: Opened current pattern and reviewed focus behavior and keyboard handling.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Editable combobox keeps text editing keys native; Down Arrow opens/moves to popup; Escape dismisses; Enter usually accepts a suggested value. Popup listbox may keep DOM focus on combobox and track active descendant.
sources.applicability: Candidate pattern for a search field and results; command activation differs from accepting a value, so Enter and active state must be adapted and AT-tested.
sources.evidence: One focus position reduces keystrokes but must not invoke the highlighted action.

critic_independent_review.locator: Keyboard interaction, listbox Enter/Escape and active descendant
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened APG pattern and read keyboard and focus descriptions.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Enter accepts a suggested value; active descendant is a web pattern with specific semantics; dialogs move focus into the dialog.
critic_independent_review.applicability: Comparison only; command execution differs from value acceptance.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide Modal Dialog Pattern
sources.released_version_or_commit: Living WAI-ARIA APG pattern; no immutable release version shown
sources.locator: Keyboard interaction; opening focus; close and return-focus notes
sources.observed_operation: Opened current pattern and reviewed modal keyboard/focus guidance.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Modal focus moves inside; Tab/Shift+Tab remain inside; Escape closes; focus normally returns to invoker unless it no longer exists or workflow makes another focus more logical.
sources.applicability: Guidance for dialog-shaped option; adapt semantics to toolkit and test rather than assuming ARIA maps perfectly.
sources.evidence: Supports a predictable dismiss-and-return editing position path.

critic_independent_review.locator: Open focus, Tab containment, Escape and return-focus notes
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened pattern and read keyboard and return-focus guidance.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Return to invoker unless it no longer exists, then focus a logical workflow target.
critic_independent_review.applicability: Adapt to target toolkit; not a native guarantee.

sources.title: Microsoft UI Automation Overview
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current Microsoft Learn documentation at retrieval; page is mutable and not pinned to a product release
sources.locator: Automation element tree, properties, control patterns, events; provider/client components
sources.observed_operation: Opened Microsoft Learn overview and reviewed UIA model description.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: UIA provides programmatic access to most desktop elements; control patterns vary by element, custom controls need appropriate provider support; framework interop does not prove a usable specific interaction.
sources.applicability: Windows accessibility-tree inspection and automated tests can supplement NVDA/Narrator manual testing.
sources.evidence: Use accessibility inspection to verify name/role/state/events, then verify actual reading and operation with screen readers.

critic_independent_review.locator: Provider API, UI elements and control-pattern sections
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened Microsoft Learn and inspected provider and pattern descriptions.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Custom control support may need a provider; control types and patterns are not one-to-one.
critic_independent_review.applicability: Windows tree/API inspection complements manual speech checks.

sources.title: GNOME Developer Accessibility Guidance
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current unversioned GNOME developer documentation at retrieval
sources.locator: AT-SPI protocol and toolkit support
sources.observed_operation: Opened GNOME developer documentation.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: AT-SPI is the application-to-AT protocol; GTK provides it for built-in widgets, while custom widget/accessibility semantics still matter. Documentation says reasonably well, not guaranteed.
sources.applicability: Linux testing should use the target toolkit's actual AT-SPI tree and Orca on supported distribution/desktop.
sources.evidence: A cross-platform API-neutral spec still needs toolkit implementation and runtime verification.

critic_independent_review.locator: AT-SPI D-Bus and GTK accessibility support
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened GNOME guidance and read AT-SPI/toolkit description.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: GTK exposes AT-SPI for its widgets; custom semantics still matter.
critic_independent_review.applicability: Linux accessibility-path reference, not proof for a custom chooser.

sources.title: Orca Screen Reader Introduction
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current Orca help page at retrieval; no immutable release pin shown
sources.locator: Orca introduction and AT-SPI supported applications/toolkits
sources.observed_operation: Opened GNOME Orca help.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Orca depends on application/toolkit support for AT-SPI; list of supported frameworks is not a guarantee for a custom control.
sources.applicability: Manual Linux screen-reader validation target when Orca is within product support.
sources.evidence: Test actual chooser names, states, focus and dynamic updates with Orca.

critic_independent_review.locator: Orca introduction and supported toolkit paragraph
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened Orca help and read its AT-SPI dependency.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Orca works with applications/toolkits supporting AT-SPI; examples do not certify this chooser.
critic_independent_review.applicability: Manual validation candidate if in support matrix.

sources.title: VS Code User Interface: Command Palette
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current product documentation, living page; exact docs release not pinned
sources.locator: Command Palette section; Ctrl+Shift+P / platform bindings
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official UI page and reviewed keyboard launch and palette usage.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Documents VS Code's command palette shortcut; do not transplant that chord to another editor without its shortcut inventory.
sources.applicability: Interaction reference for keyboard-first command access and multi-purpose quick-input panel.
sources.evidence: Illustrates a known command chooser product, not a winning design.

sources.title: VS Code Editor Tutorial: Fuzzy Search
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current product documentation, living page; exact docs release not pinned
sources.locator: Fuzzy matching statement for files or commands
sources.observed_operation: Opened official tutorial and reviewed search statement.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: The page says VS Code uses fuzzy matching; it does not claim arbitrary spelling correction or define an edit-distance threshold.
sources.applicability: Supports fuzzy subsequence as one alternative, not proof that it satisfies typo tolerance.
sources.evidence: Do not equate the term fuzzy with typo-correcting.

sources.title: VS Code Extension API QuickPick
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current weekly extension API docs; mutable and not pinned to a specific VS Code release
sources.locator: QuickPick, QuickPickItem, QuickPickOptions; label, description, detail, ariaLabel, onDidChangeValue, items, matchOnDescription/Detail
sources.observed_operation: Opened reference and searched QuickPick item/options definitions.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Descriptions/details are secondary fields; API docs say matchOnDescription defaults false; detail matching is separately configurable. Interface does not itself define a target editor's disabled reason behavior.
sources.applicability: Shows host-managed structured row metadata and input change events; validate actual speech behavior.
sources.evidence: Use separate visible/accessibility text for name, shortcut, scope, reason; control which secondary fields are searchable.

critic_independent_review.locator: QuickPick matchOnDescription and matchOnDetail API properties
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened official API page and read matching defaults.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Description/detail matching are separate and default false; no disabled-reason or screen-reader guarantee.

sources.title: VS Code Extension Commands Guide
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current weekly extension API docs; mutable, includes version note from VS Code 1.74
sources.locator: Registering a command; making a user-facing command available via package.json contribution
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official commands guide; page explains registerCommand and command contribution.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: A registered handler binds runtime logic; manifest contribution makes it discoverable. Since VS Code 1.74, declared commands auto-activate when invoked; earlier versions require explicit onCommand activation.
sources.applicability: Reference for separating declarative command metadata from host-owned UI and runtime action handler.
sources.evidence: The extension must supply action logic, but need not supply UI code.

sources.title: VS Code Keyboard Shortcuts
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current product documentation, living page; exact docs release not pinned
sources.locator: when-clause contexts and keybinding examples
sources.observed_operation: Opened keyboard shortcuts page and reviewed context-scoped bindings.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: A keybinding with no when clause is globally available; a when clause scopes it. This is a product-specific model, not a cross-editor conflict policy.
sources.applicability: Inspect target command/keybinding manager; do not take over an existing command or rely on a bare printable key.
sources.evidence: Scope and conflict review belong in integration rather than hardcoded OS assumptions.

sources.title: VS Code QuickInput internal model
sources.released_version_or_commit: VS Code GitHub main snapshot at full commit 9b463ccc1d17131640406ee961b4724c0ec75433 (retrieved through GitHub API and pinned source URL)
sources.locator: IQuickItem/IQuickPickItem, IQuickPick ariaLabel/onDidChangeValue/items/matchOnLabelMode and matching properties
sources.observed_operation: Opened exact commit source; searched interface definitions.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Internal picker supports fuzzy or contiguous label matching; description/detail matching are separate flags. IQuickItem disabled property is described in the multi-select context, not a general availability reason contract.
sources.applicability: Useful concrete control model; custom internal source is not public API or proof of screen-reader success.
sources.evidence: Command row can carry stable ID, label and accessible label; filtering behavior is explicit/configurable.

critic_independent_review.locator: Pinned Quick Input matchOnLabelMode and description/detail options
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened exact commit and inspected Quick Pick interface.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Fuzzy/contiguous label modes; description/detail are separate options. Internal source is not a public target contract.

sources.title: VS Code command palette provider
sources.released_version_or_commit: VS Code GitHub main snapshot at full commit 9b463ccc1d17131640406ee961b4724c0ec75433
sources.locator: CommandsQuickAccessProvider; lines 938-1006 extensionRegistrationRace; getCommandPicks; getGlobalCommandPicks at 1225-1287; ShowAllCommandsAction
sources.observed_operation: Opened exact commit and searched registration wait, enabled filter, labels/categories/aliases, and launch action.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Waits for installed extensions or 800 ms once. Menu provider filters to enabled MenuItemAction items, so disabled commands are hidden. This does not establish live add/remove refresh after chooser open.
sources.applicability: Analogy for integrating a chooser with existing extension command registry; its hide-disabled policy fails the requested unavailable-reason behavior.
sources.evidence: Builds display labels/categories/aliases and stable command IDs, but hides disabled actions.

critic_independent_review.locator: Pinned command provider extension registration wait and enabled-action filter
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened exact commit and read provider code.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Waits for installed extension registration or 800 ms once; filters menu actions to enabled commands, hiding unavailable actions.
critic_independent_review.applicability: Comparator only; does not meet unavailable-reason requirement or prove live updates.

sources.title: VS Code Quick Input browser tests
sources.released_version_or_commit: VS Code GitHub main snapshot at full commit 9b463ccc1d17131640406ee961b4724c0ec75433
sources.locator: selectedItems replacement and keepScrollPosition tests around source lines 2427-2485
sources.observed_operation: Opened exact commit and searched item replacement/scroll behavior tests.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Unit tests verify control state/scroll only; they do not evaluate NVDA, Orca, UIA/AT-SPI mapping or announcements.
sources.applicability: Test-design reference for dynamic result list stability, not a screen-reader validation substitute.
sources.evidence: A replacement list can reset selection; preserve focus by stable ID and test removal of the focused item.

critic_independent_review.locator: Pinned source keepScrollPosition around 2475–2485; selectedItems replacement test 2489–2522
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened exact test file and inspected these cases.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Control state/scroll tests only; no AT-tree, NVDA or Orca validation.

sources.title: VS Code PR #281303 proposes Quick Pick refresh()
sources.released_version_or_commit: Open pull request; exact files diff commit 36ea28f43b5b4ffdf8bed3db9ada14ecebb2d462; not a released version
sources.locator: quickInput.ts reload implementation; common IQuickPick reload docs; quickinput.test.ts repeated reload and empty query cases
sources.observed_operation: Opened PR page and exact commit diff, including tests.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Proposed reload re-fires onDidChangeValue with current query so provider can refresh without changing input; PR was open at retrieval and not treated as shipped.
sources.applicability: Design precedent for host-side refresh events if registry changes while open; implementation must also preserve active item/focus and throttle announcements.
sources.evidence: Dynamic model refresh should avoid resetting text query.

critic_independent_review.status: mismatched; do not use as evidence; original ID preserved
critic_independent_review.locator: Exact PR URL and linked commit URL 36ea28f43b5b4ffdf8bed3db9ada14ecebb2d462
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened PR and commit URLs separately.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: PR resolves to unrelated Quick Bar change; linked commit is a merge of main into main, not a Quick Pick refresh patch.
critic_independent_review.applicability: Quarantined pointer; do not silently rebind.

sources.title: VS Code issue #152291 NVDA focus regression
sources.released_version_or_commit: Issue opened 2022-06; reporter verified an Insiders fix in July 2022; stable release version not established by issue excerpt
sources.locator: Windows/NVDA report; CalculateNativeWinOcclusion workaround; Insiders fixed/verified comments and maintainer's build-specific scope
sources.observed_operation: Opened issue and reviewed report, maintainer discussion, workaround, fix announcement, and reporter verification.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Reporter environment was Windows NVDA with Microsoft Electron build after upgrade; maintainer could not reproduce on own VM; workaround was --disable-features=CalculateNativeWinOcclusion; issue notes upstream Electron was unaffected.
sources.applicability: Narrow history case demonstrating runtime/build-specific focus regressions; not transferable evidence about another editor.
sources.evidence: Real AT validation across supported builds is required in addition to semantics and widget tests.

critic_independent_review.locator: Issue report, June 2022 workaround/maintainer discussion, July 2022 Insiders fix and verification
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Read reporter conditions, workaround, maintainer non-reproduction, and later verification.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Narrow Windows/NVDA report on a particular VS Code Insiders/Electron build; later Insiders fix/verification, not a general defect claim.

sources.title: CKEditor 5 Core Editor Architecture
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current CKEditor 5 framework docs (latest, mutable; no version pinned)
sources.locator: Core editor architecture; Commands section; command state and forceDisabled
sources.observed_operation: Opened framework documentation and reviewed editor.commands, execute, isEnabled and observable properties.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Commands combine action/state; isEnabled depends on selection/context; `affectsData=false` exempts non-data commands from read-only disablement; forceDisabled/clearForceDisabled manage outside restrictions.
sources.applicability: Editor-centric model for keeping command state separate from UI; does not provide chooser/search interaction.
sources.evidence: Availability should be a live registry/state concept, not an inferred visual color.

critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened CKEditor architecture docs and inspected observable command state.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Command state is observable and context-dependent; docs do not specify an accessible chooser.

sources.title: CKEditor 5 command registration and state tutorial
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current CKEditor 5 docs (latest, mutable; no version pinned)
sources.locator: Registering a command; refresh() and execute(); selection-restricted Highlight example
sources.observed_operation: Opened tutorial and reviewed command registration and sample refresh logic.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: refresh is called as model changes; isEnabled expresses selection-allowed state; execute contains command logic.
sources.applicability: Alternative command-state model for selection-dependent operations in a writing editor.
sources.evidence: A command registry can answer whether execution is possible for current selection.

sources.title: CKEditor 5 KeystrokeHandler API
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current CKEditor 5 API docs (latest, mutable; no version pinned)
sources.locator: KeystrokeHandler.set() and callback's cancel helper
sources.observed_operation: Opened API page and reviewed handler registration contract.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Handler runs for registered key combinations; cancel helper prevents default and stops propagation. Existing editing bindings must be inventoried before handling keys.
sources.applicability: Shows that a local handler can consume editor shortcuts; do not install broad interception for the chooser.
sources.evidence: Scope opening behavior to the chooser command and preserve preexisting bindings.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG Menu and Menubar Pattern
sources.released_version_or_commit: Living WAI-ARIA APG pattern; no immutable release version shown
sources.locator: About This Pattern; disabled item focus/activation notes; aria-disabled state; keyboard navigation
sources.observed_operation: Opened the current APG pattern and reviewed disabled-menu behavior and keyboard interaction.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: For menu semantics, disabled menu items are focusable but cannot be activated and use aria-disabled=true. This behavior is specific to menu pattern and must not be borrowed by a listbox/combobox without matching its pattern.
sources.applicability: Supports discoverability of unavailable commands only if a menu-style interaction is actually chosen; does not settle semantics for a searchbox-controlled list.
sources.evidence: Availability reason must accompany the disabled state and Enter must be a no-op.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG Developing a Keyboard Interface
sources.released_version_or_commit: Living WAI-ARIA APG practice; no immutable release version shown
sources.locator: Focusability of disabled controls; removing focused element and logical focus handling; active descendant
sources.observed_operation: Opened the current keyboard-interface guidance and reviewed focus movement/composite-widget sections.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: For discoverability, an otherwise disabled control may remain focusable with aria-disabled=true; if an element with focus is removed, focus should move to a logical element. Guidance is web APG and not universal platform behavior.
sources.applicability: Useful for deciding how to keep unavailable commands discoverable and how to handle removal of the active extension row.
sources.evidence: Dynamic command removal must not leave a stale focused row; choose a logical replacement and do not invoke the removed action.

critic_independent_review.locator: Focus loss when active element is removed; discoverable disabled controls
critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened keyboard interface practice and reviewed focus and disabled-element guidance.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Web guidance; disabled controls may remain focusable when discoverability matters, and removal requires managed focus.

sources.title: Accessible Rich Internet Applications (WAI-ARIA) 1.2
sources.released_version_or_commit: W3C Recommendation, 2023-06-06
sources.locator: Focus management; aria-activedescendant; author responsibility after removing the focused element; aria-disabled
sources.observed_operation: Opened the fixed W3C recommendation and reviewed author obligations for composite focus and active descendant.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Web user agents communicate active descendant as if focused; authors manage focus for composites and should move focus logically if focused element is removed. Semantic mapping/support depends on user agent and accessibility technology.
sources.applicability: Grounds dynamic active-row management for a web-based runtime; WCAG2ICT and real UIA/AT-SPI testing remain necessary for desktop.
sources.evidence: Do not assume retaining a row that no longer has a registered command is safe.

critic_independent_review.observed_operation: Opened WAI-ARIA 1.2 and inspected author focus obligations.
critic_independent_review.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Authors should move focus to a logical element if focused element is removed; active descendant is role-dependent and mapped by user agents.
critic_independent_review.applicability: Web specification; does not guarantee consistent screen-reader speech.

critic_review.method: Independent full-package review and direct primary-source rechecks
critic_review.source_record_policy: Original source IDs, URLs, titles and investigator records are preserved. Critic observations are additive; mismatched sources are flagged without rebinding.
critic_review.target_repo_note: The assigned brief/input map supplies no target repository, toolkit, callers or tests.
